title_en: Death toll rises in Ukraine after Russia attacks aid centre, hospice and hospital
title_zh: 俄罗斯袭击援助中心、临终关怀中心和医院后乌克兰死亡人数上升
summary: At least 38 people are killed in 24 hours and Ukraine's Volodymyr Zelensky warns dozens more could be trapped under rubble.
summary_zh: 24 小时内至少有 38 人死亡，乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基 (Volodymyr Zelensky) 警告称，可能还有数十人被困在废墟下。
body_en: Death toll rises in Ukraine after Russia attacks aid centre, hospice and hospital - BBC News
Russian strikes on Ukraine – including on an aid centre, a hospice and a hospital – have killed at least 38 civilians and injured scores of others over the last 24 hours.

At least 33 people are known to have died in a glide bomb attack in the southern Zaporizhzhia region on Monday night, and President Volodymyr Zelensky said the number of victims was set to rise as more than 50 people could be trapped under the rubble.
He called the strike in Komyshuvakha village "one of the largest mass killings committed by Russia during this war".
Ukraine had proposed to extend and expand last week's ceasefire in the Kherson region which allowed people from the frontline Russian-occupied town of Oleshky to evacuate, Zelensky added.
The attack on a school building being used as an aid distribution centre in Komyshuvakha was Moscow's response, he said.
Elsewhere, a hospice was attacked in the central city of Dnipro and a hospital was hit in the north-eastern city of Kharkiv, where Zelensky said 73 people were wounded, most of them elderly patients.

Nine 3,000kg aerial bombs hit Komyshuvakha as residents were gathering to receive humanitarian aid at a distribution centre, authorities said. Local media reported that when the attack began, people took refuge underground but the roof collapsed, trapping many underneath.
"The scale of the tragedy is difficult to comprehend," regional head Mykhailo Semikin said.
Russia's defense ministry said the attack had targeted Ukrainian military units and killed 25 servicemen.

However, there was no credible evidence that the site was being used by the Ukrainian military and there were no major military or industrial facilities in the settlement of Komyshuvakha, reports BBC News Russian defence correspondent Ilya Abishev.
The village is to the south-east of the city of Zaporizhzhia, which has come under constant Russian bombardment.
According to Abishev, Komyshuvakha is of high military importance as part of Ukraine's defensive and transport network on the approaches to the regional capital.

But the UN's human rights monitoring mission said the distribution of humanitarian aid at the local school had been highly publicised and the attack "seems to have violated the most fundamental principles of international humanitarian law" , external .
Image source, Dnipropetrovsk authorities/Telegram

Further north, in Dnipro, nearly 50 terminally ill patients were being transferred to other facilities after their hospice was destroyed by a Russian missile on Monday night. The oldest of the patients was 90 years old.
Mayor Boris Filatov posted photos on Telegram showing elderly people lying in their beds in a hospice room with blown-out windows and rubble and broken glass strewn on the floors.
"I realise that I am violating ethics," wrote Filatov. "I want as many people as possible to see these photos. Especially politicians and diplomats. Especially abroad.
"These are elderly, terminally ill people. This is a Russian missile."
Elsewhere in Dnipro, a separate strike killed two people and left 18 others wounded. Another five people were killed in aerial bomb and drone strikes on Ukraine's eastern Donetsk region.
body_zh: 俄罗斯袭击援助中心、临终关怀中心和医院后乌克兰死亡人数上升 -_澳门赌博平台
过去 24 小时内，俄罗斯对乌克兰的袭击（包括对一个援助中心、一家临终关怀医院和一家医院的袭击）已造成至少 38 名平民死亡，数十人受伤。
据了解，周一晚间扎波罗热南部地区发生的滑翔炸弹袭击已造成至少 33 人死亡，总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基表示，受害者人数预计还会增加，因为可能有 50 多人被困在废墟下。
他称科梅舒瓦卡村的袭击是“俄罗斯在这场战争中犯下的最大规模的屠杀之一”。
泽连斯基补充说，乌克兰提议延长和扩大上周在赫尔松地区的停火，允许来自俄罗斯占领的前线城镇奥列什基的人们撤离。
他说，针对科梅舒瓦卡用作援助分发中心的学校建筑的袭击是莫斯科的回应。
其他地方，中部城市第聂伯罗的一家临终关怀医院遭到袭击，东北部城市哈尔科夫的一家医院也遭到袭击，泽伦斯基说，那里有 73 人受伤，其中大多数是老年患者。
当局称，当居民聚集在分发中心领取人道主义援助时，九枚 3000 公斤的空投炸弹袭击了 Komyshuvakha。当地媒体报道称，袭击开始时，人们逃到地下避难，但屋顶倒塌，许多人被困在下面。
地区负责人米哈伊洛·塞米金 (Mykhailo Semikin) 表示：“这场悲剧的规模令人难以理解。”
俄罗斯国防部表示，此次袭击针对乌克兰军事单位，造成 25 名军人死亡。
然而，据英国广播公司新闻俄罗斯防务记者伊利亚·阿比舍夫报道，没有可靠的证据表明该地点正在被乌克兰军方使用，并且科梅舒瓦卡定居点内没有重大军事或工业设施。
该村庄位于扎波罗热市东南部，该市一直受到俄罗斯的轰炸。
阿比舍夫表示，科梅舒瓦卡是乌克兰通往地区首府的防御和运输网络的一部分，具有很高的军事重要性。
但联合国人权监测团表示，当地学校分发人道主义援助物资的情况已被广泛宣传，此次袭击“似乎违反了国际人道主义法的最基本原则”。
图片来源，第聂伯罗彼得罗夫斯克当局/Telegram
再往北，在第聂伯罗，近 50 名绝症患者的临终关怀中心周一晚上被俄罗斯导弹摧毁，目前正在被转移到其他设施。患者中年龄最大的已经90岁了。
市长鲍里斯·菲拉托夫在 Telegram 上发布的照片​​显示，老人躺在临终关怀室的床上，窗户被炸毁，地板上散落着瓦砾和碎玻璃。
“我意识到我违反了道德规范，”菲拉托夫写道。 “我希望尽可能多的人看到这些照片。尤其是政治家和外交官。尤其是在国外。
“这些人都是上了年纪、身患绝症的人。这是俄罗斯导弹。”
在第聂伯罗的其他地方，另一次袭击造成两人死亡、18 人受伤。乌克兰东部顿涅茨克地区的空袭和无人机袭击造成另外五人死亡。

title_en: Europe on alert after supermarket freezers hit by cyber-attacks in 10 countries
title_zh: 欧洲10个国家超市冰柜遭受网络攻击后保持警惕
summary: Supermarkets have reported problems from Estonia and Sweden to Portugal and Italy and many retainers have been forced to discard food.
summary_zh: 从爱沙尼亚和瑞典到葡萄牙和意大利，超市都报告了问题，许多保留者被迫丢弃食物。
body_en: A spate of cyber-attacks that hit supermarket chains across at least 10 European countries on Monday has prompted European Union officials to warn of a deliberate attempt to disrupt the food supply chain.

Supermarkets have reported problems in Belgium, Estonia, Finland, Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Portugal, Germany and Sweden, and the significant increase in freezer temperatures has forced retailers to discard food.
Temperatures in chains across Europe reportedly rose as high as 50C (122F).
No-one has yet admitted carrying out the cyber-attacks.

The European Union has raised concerns about the attacks, which come three weeks after a cyber-attack disrupted as many as 700 French grocery stores, causing food losses estimated at tens of millions of euros.
The security of refrigeration systems as well as other devices that can be monitored remotely has heightened concerns about government-backed hybrid attacks.
The EU's food and agriculture commissioner, Christophe Hansen, said the bloc was taking the incidents very seriously and warned of further disruption in the future.

Commission spokesman Thomas Regnier was careful not to attribute blame, but said: "These incidents of course show once again how cyber-attacks can disrupt essential services and affect citizens' daily lives."
"These are not isolated incidents and of course we have to be collectively resilient and prepared for such cyber incidents."

In Italy , Giorgia Meloni's government called a meeting with intelligence chiefs, but said the impact was "currently very limited" and most of the food distribution chain had up-to-date security systems able to fend off such attacks.
At least four Co-op supermarkets in Sicily and one business in Tuscany were affected, according to the national cybersecurity agency.
Meloni's office said those businesses affected were "mostly still equipped with obsolete security systems, with interfaces directly exposed to the internet and inadequate authentication mechanisms".
Belgian supermarkets were among those hardest-hit, with dozens of stores reporting refrigeration failures. Federal prosecutors have opened an investigation.
UK meat industry hit by cyber-attack which targeted European supermarket freezers

Mathieu Tilman, a manager at a Delhaize supermarket in Belgium, said he was shocked by this kind of attack: "I don't even understand how anyone could do this... How can we end up throwing away so much food? I find it truly distressing. In moments like these, you just feel like quitting your job."

In Ireland , 13 SuperValu stores were impacted by what the chain's owner, Musgrave Group, called a cyber-incident. "Replenishment of chilled and frozen ranges in the affected stores is well under way," a spokesman said on Monday.
A small number of corner shops in the Netherlands also suffered disruption. Last month, supermarket chain Albert Heijn had to take several services offline because of a separate cyber-attack.

There was disruption to refrigeration systems at the Rewe Büsken supermarket in western Germany after a cyber-attack on system provider Danfoss, the company told the BBC. Its systems have been back in operation since Monday afternoon.

In Portugal , the Mosqueteiros group said that incidents at seven Intermarché stores had been linked to a cyberattack, which "appears to have targeted an external service provider responsible for managing the refrigeration systems".

Swedish chain ICA also said "a limited number" of its stores had experienced refrigeration problems, without confirming a cyber-attack, and Sweden's national cyber-security agencies said they were monitoring the incident.
body_zh: 周一，至少 10 个欧洲国家的连锁超市遭受一连串网络攻击，促使欧盟官员发出警告，称有人蓄意破坏食品供应链。
比利时、爱沙尼亚、芬兰、爱尔兰、意大利、卢森堡、荷兰、葡萄牙、德国和瑞典的超市都报告了问题，冷冻室温度大幅升高迫使零售商丢弃食物。
据报道，欧洲各地连锁店的温度高达 50 摄氏度（122 华氏度）。
目前尚未有人承认实施了网络攻击。
欧盟对这些攻击表示担忧，三周前，法国多达 700 家杂货店遭受网络攻击，造成估计数千万欧元的粮食损失。
制冷系统以及其他可远程监控设备的安全性加剧了人们对政府支持的混合攻击的担忧。
欧盟粮食和农业专员克里斯托夫·汉森表示，欧盟正在非常严肃地对待这些事件，并警告未来可能会出现进一步的破坏。
委员会发言人托马斯·雷尼尔（Thomas Regnier）小心翼翼地不去指责，但表示：“这些事件当然再次表明网络攻击如何扰乱基本服务并影响公民的日常生活。”
“这些不是孤立的事件，当然我们必须集体保持弹性，并为此类网络事件做好准备。”
在意大利，乔治亚·梅洛尼政府召集了情报主管会议，但表示影响“目前非常有限”，大多数食品分销链都拥有能够抵御此类攻击的最新安全系统。
据国家网络安全机构称，西西里岛至少有四家合作超市和托斯卡纳的一家企业受到影响。
梅洛尼办公室表示，受影响的企业“大多数仍然配备过时的安全系统，接口直接暴露在互联网上，身份验证机制不足”。
比利时超市是受影响最严重的超市之一，数十家商店报告制冷故障。联邦检察官已展开调查。
英国肉类行业遭受针对欧洲超市冰柜的网络攻击
比利时德尔海兹一家超市的经理马蒂厄·蒂尔曼说，他对这种袭击感到震惊：“我什至不明白怎么会有人这么做……我们怎么会扔掉这么多食物？我觉得这真的很令人痛苦。在这样的时刻，你只想辞职。”
In Ireland , 13 SuperValu stores were impacted by what the chain's owner, Musgrave Group, called a cyber-incident.一位发言人周一表示：“受影响商店的冷藏和冷冻产品的补充工作正在顺利进行。”
荷兰的少数街角商店也受到干扰。上个月，连锁超市 Albert Heijn 由于另一次网络攻击而不得不关闭多项服务。
德国西部的 Rewe Büsken 超市告诉 BBC，系统供应商丹佛斯遭受网络攻击后，该超市的制冷系统出现中断。自周一下午以来，其系统已恢复运行。
在葡萄牙，Mosqueteiros 组织表示，七家 Intermarché 商店发生的事件与网络攻击有关，该攻击“似乎针对的是负责管理制冷系统的外部服务提供商”。
瑞典连锁店 ICA 还表示，其“有限数量”的商店出现了制冷问题，但未确认是否受到网络攻击，瑞典国家网络安全机构表示正在监控这一事件。

title_en: US strikes Iranian island ahead of midterm elections
title_zh: 美国在中期选举前袭击伊朗岛屿
summary: US officials described the attacks on Qeshm Island as limited and defensive, according to CBS, the BBC's US partner.
summary_zh: 据英国广播公司美国合作伙伴哥伦比亚广播公司称，美国官员称对格什姆岛的袭击是有限的和防御性的。
body_en: The US has carried out strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz, US officials have told CBS, the BBC's US partner.
The officials described the strikes as limited and defensive, and said they were in response to Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) firing on a US aircraft.

Iranian state news agency Irna reported explosions on Qeshm on Monday. The IRGC did not comment but said its forces had shot down two US MQM-170 drones south of the island and a US MQ-9 drone east of the Strait of Hormuz.
The US military has not commented on the strikes, which came as mediators stepped up their efforts to prevent a return to all-out war after the US midterm elections on Tuesday.
Trump has been facing falling polling numbers and pressure from within his Republican Party to end the war, which began when the US and Israel attacked Iran in February.
Earlier on Monday, the president told reporters that he was in "no rush" to ramp up strikes on Iran.

"One way or the other, we will do something, but there is no rush. We crippled them financially," he told news outlet Axios. "They have no money, no gasoline and their people are getting very tired of it."
He also said the US "might need to go after Pickaxe [Mountain]", an underground site linked to Iran's nuclear programme, in an interview with Fox News on the eve of the midterms.
This was "not a big deal" and could be done in "one hour", Trump added.

There has been mounting speculation in the last few days that the US may resume significant strikes in Iran again after the midterms. But asked by a reporter on Monday if that was the case, Trump said "no".

Meanwhile, the Associated Press cited two regional officials as saying that, during a weekend phone call, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu had pushed Trump for another wave of strikes on Iran following the midterms.
On Tuesday, Iran's chief negotiator with the US, parliament speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, stated: "The ball is now in America's court to prevent war."
"Just as the Islamic Republic of Iran stands ready for battle with its finger on the trigger, it has also given the American side a powerful and rational response," he said in a televised speech.

It was not immediately clear what Ghalibaf was referring to, but Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi told Irna on Monday that "very intensive" talks to try to end the war were under way with the US via Qatari and Pakistani mediators.
Qatar's foreign ministry spokesman said on Tuesday that both sides were "reviewing the ideas and proposals we have presented" and that it remained hopeful of a deal being agreed.
"Both parties remain committed to the negotiation process... We are facilitating the real-time exchange of proposals between them," Majed al-Ansari told reporters in Doha.

Last week, Iranian negotiators discussed with mediators a proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz within two days once the US met its seven conditions. They reportedly include lifting a naval blockade of Iranian ports and releasing frozen Iranian assets.

The Strait of Hormuz, through which a fifth of global oil and gas shipments usually pass, was effectively closed after the start of the Iran war due to Iranian missile and drone attacks on commercial vessels and the US naval blockade.

The US and Iran reached a preliminary agreement to end the war and reopen the strait in June, but it collapsed within weeks after Iranian attacks on shipping resumed and the US reinstated its blockade.

Iran insisted it would not give up some measure of control over the waterway and began targeting vessels using a southern route through Omani waters that avoids its preferred route through Iranian waters.
body_zh: 美国官员告诉英国广播公司美国合作伙伴哥伦比亚广播公司，美国对霍尔木兹海峡的伊朗格什姆岛进行了袭击。
官员们称这次袭击是有限的和防御性的，并表示这是对伊朗伊斯兰革命卫队（IRGC）向一架美国飞机开火的回应。
伊朗国家通讯社伊朗通讯社周一报道了格什姆岛发生爆炸事件。伊朗革命卫队没有发表评论，但表示其部队击落了该岛以南的两架美国 MQM-170 无人机和霍尔木兹海峡以东的一架美国 MQ-9 无人机。
美国军方尚未对此次袭击发表评论，此次袭击发生之际，调解者在周二美国中期选举后加紧努力，防止全面战争重新爆发。
特朗普一直面临着民意调查数字下降和共和党内部要求结束战争的压力，这场战争是从美国和以色列二月份袭击伊朗时开始的。
周一早些时候，总统告诉记者，他“不急于”加大对伊朗的打击力度。
他对新闻媒体 Axios 表示：“不管怎样，我们都会做点什么，但不要着急。我们在经济上削弱了他们的能力。” “他们没有钱，没有汽油，他们的人民对此感到非常厌倦。”
他还在中期选举前夕接受福克斯新闻采访时表示，美国“可能需要追查与伊朗核计划有关的镐山”。
特朗普补充说，这“没什么大不了的”，可以在“一小时内”完成。
过去几天，越来越多的人猜测美国可能会在中期选举后再次恢复对伊朗的大规模打击。但周一被记者问及情况是否如此时，特朗普说“不”。
与此同时，美联社援引两名地区官员的话说，以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡在周末的电话中敦促特朗普在中期选举后对伊朗进行另一波打击。
周二，伊朗与美国的首席谈判代表、议会议长穆罕默德·巴格尔·加利巴夫表示：“防止战争的球现在落在了美国的手里。”
他在电视讲话中表示，“就在伊朗伊斯兰共和国扣动扳机做好战斗准备的同时，它也向美方做出了强有力、理性的回应。”
目前尚不清楚加利巴夫指的是什么，但伊朗外交部长阿巴斯·阿拉格奇周一告诉《伊朗伊斯兰通讯社》，伊朗正在通过卡塔尔和巴基斯坦调解人与美国进行“非常密集”的会谈，试图结束战争。
卡塔尔外交部发言人周二表示，双方正在“审查我们提出的想法和建议”，并且仍然对达成协议抱有希望。
马吉德·安萨里在多哈对记者说：“双方仍然致力于谈判进程……我们正在促进他们之间实时交换建议。”
上周，伊朗谈判代表与调解人讨论了一项提议，一旦美国满足七项条件，伊朗将在两天内重新开放霍尔木兹海峡。据报道，这些措施包括解除对伊朗港口的海上封锁并释放冻结的伊朗资产。
全球五分之一的石油和天然气运输通常要经过霍尔木兹海峡，但在伊朗战争爆发后，由于伊朗导弹和无人机对商船的袭击以及美国的海上封锁，该海峡实际上被关闭。
美国和伊朗于六月达成了结束战争并重新开放海峡的初步协议，但在伊朗恢复对航运的袭击以及美国恢复封锁后几周内该协议就破裂了。
伊朗坚称不会放弃对该水道的某种控制措施，并开始针对使用通过阿曼水域的南部航线的船只，该航线避开了伊朗水域的首选航线。

title_en: Hundreds evacuate city during temporary ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine
title_zh: 俄罗斯和乌克兰临时停火期间数百人撤离城市
summary: The ceasefire in a Russian-occupied Ukrainian city has ended. The ceasefire, which lasted several days, allowed hundreds of residents to evacuate.
summary_zh: 俄罗斯占领的乌克兰城市的停火已经结束。停火持续了几天，数百名居民得以撤离。
body_en: Hundreds evacuate city during temporary ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine : NPR

Hundreds evacuate city during temporary ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine The ceasefire in a Russian-occupied Ukrainian city has ended. The ceasefire, which lasted several days, allowed hundreds of residents to evacuate.

The ceasefire in a Russian-occupied Ukrainian city has ended. The ceasefire, which lasted several days, allowed hundreds of residents to evacuate.

A ceasefire brokered by Pope Leo and Melania Trump in a corner of southern Ukraine has ended. The truce enabled the evacuation of hundreds of residents in a Russian-occupied town, and across the river in the Ukrainian-held city of Kherson, the truce also allowed residents to walk the streets without being targeted by Russian drones. NPR's Joanna Kakissis traveled there this weekend and is on the line from Kyiv. Good morning, Joanna.
JOANNA KAKISSIS, BYLINE: Good morning, Leila.

KAKISSIS: Well, Leila, tunnels of heavy-duty nets cover nearly every street and many of the buildings in Kherson, if you can imagine that. These nets help protect residents from drones because for the last couple of years, Russian soldiers have used FPV, or first-person view drones strapped with explosives, to actually hunt and kill civilians in Kherson. So Russian troops are also about a mile away across a river. They also drop a lot of guided air bombs into the city.

Now, this is a city I first visited in late 2022, right after Ukrainian forces freed Kherson from Russian occupation. Last time I was there was about a year ago. It's a lovely city filled with parks, but, you know, Russian forces have destroyed so many buildings there, and people never left their homes while I was there last time without drone detectors and sometimes even body armor.
FADEL: So how much has changed since you were last there, especially given there was a ceasefire this weekend?
KAKISSIS: Well, Leila, the locals were not wearing body armor this time, and the city did show signs of normal life.

KAKISSIS: We saw people strolling outside with their kids, stocking up on groceries, having coffee in the sun. And at one very busy cafe, we met two best friends, Anna Hersomenko (ph) and Olena Soboleva (ph). They are 21 years old, and here's Olena.
OLENA SOBOLEVA: There is no drones. There is no explosions. It is like a feeling that no one wants to kill you.
KAKISSIS: And Anna told us she took the opportunity to walk to a salon.
ANNA HERSOMENKO: Last two days, I did my nails. Paint my nail. Yeah.
HERSOMENKO: Yes. Thank you a million. Really, it's definitely a lot of people now walking around. A lot of cars.
KAKISSIS: Now, these two friends, Leila, live on the same street, but they only see each other in person about once a month because it's usually so dangerous to walk outside.

FADEL: Wow. So a little bit of a respite for them. So Kherson relaxed a little during the ceasefire, as you pointed out. This truce, though, was negotiated to help a town across the river. What happened there?

KAKISSIS: Well, yeah, Russia and Ukraine agreed to the ceasefire to help the town of Oleshky. This town is occupied by Russian forces, which mined the land around it. Trucks delivering food and medicine could not get in for several months. Some residents in Oleshky were eating boiled weeds to survive. Now, during the ceasefire, hundreds of residents were evacuated from the town, and many went to northern Ukraine to meet their families.
FADEL: Now, the truce ended Sunday night. So does that mean back to war for everyone?
body_zh: 俄罗斯和乌克兰临时停火期间数百人撤离城市：NPR
俄罗斯和乌克兰临时停火期间数百人撤离城市 俄罗斯占领的乌克兰一座城市的停火已经结束。停火持续了几天，数百名居民得以撤离。
俄罗斯和乌克兰临时停火期间数百人撤离城市
俄罗斯占领的乌克兰城市的停火已经结束。停火持续了几天，数百名居民得以撤离。
由教皇利奥和梅拉尼娅·特朗普斡旋在乌克兰南部一角达成的停火协议已经结束。停战协议使俄罗斯占领的一个城镇的数百名居民得以疏散，而在河对岸的乌克兰控制的赫尔松市，停战协议还允许居民在街道上行走而不会成为俄罗斯无人机的目标。 NPR 的乔安娜·卡基西斯 (Joanna Kakissis) 本周末从基辅前往那里。早上好，乔安娜。
乔安娜·卡基西斯连线：早上好，莱拉。
卡基西斯：好吧，莱拉，重型网的隧道几乎覆盖了赫尔松的每条街道和许多建筑物，如果你能想象的话。这些网有助于保护居民免受无人机袭击，因为在过去的几年里，俄罗斯士兵使用 FPV（第一人称视角无人机）绑着炸药，在赫尔松实际猎杀平民。因此，俄罗斯军队也在大约一英里外的河对岸。他们还向城市投掷了大量制导炸弹。
现在，这是我在 2022 年底首次访问的城市，当时乌克兰军队将赫尔松从俄罗斯占领下解放出来。我上次去那里是大约一年前。这是一个充满公园的可爱城市，但是，你知道，俄罗斯军队摧毁了那里的许多建筑物，当我上次在那里时，人们从未离开过自己的家，没有无人机探测器，有时甚至没有防弹衣。
FADEL：那么，自您上次访问以来发生了多少变化，特别是考虑到本周末停火了？
卡基西斯：嗯，莱拉，这次当地人没有穿防弹衣，这座城市确实表现出了正常生活的迹象。
卡基西斯：我们看到人们带着孩子在外面散步，购买杂货，在阳光下喝咖啡。在一家非常繁忙的咖啡馆，我们遇到了两位最好的朋友，安娜·赫索缅科（Anna Hersomenko）（博士）和奥莱娜·索博列娃（Olena Soboleva）（博士）。他们今年 21 岁，这是奥琳娜。
奥琳娜·索博列娃：没有无人机。没有爆炸。这就像一种没有人想杀你的感觉。
卡基西斯：安娜告诉我们她借此机会步行去了一家沙龙。
安娜·赫索门科：过去两天，我做了指甲。画我的指甲。是的。
赫尔索门科：是的。谢谢你一百万。确实，现在肯定有很多人在四处走动。很多车。
卡基西斯：现在，莱拉这两个朋友住在同一条街上，但他们大约每月只见面一次，因为外面走路通常很危险。
法德尔：哇。所以给他们一点喘息的机会。正如你所指出的，赫尔松在停火期间放松了一些。不过，这次休战是为了帮助河对岸的一个城镇而谈判的。那里发生了什么？
卡基西斯：嗯，是的，俄罗斯和乌克兰同意停火以帮助奥列什基镇。这个城镇被俄罗斯军队占领，并在其周围的土地上埋设了地雷。运送食品和药品的卡车几个月都无法进入。奥列什基的一些居民靠吃煮熟的杂草来生存。现在，在停火期间，数百名居民从该镇撤离，许多人前往乌克兰北部与家人团聚。
法德尔：现在，停战协议于周日晚上结束。那么这是否意味着每个人都会回到战争呢？

title_zh: 加拿大疑似灰熊袭击致一人死亡、一人失踪
summary: The incident took place in the same province where a grizzly attacked a group of schoolchildren last November A mother is dead and her daughter is missing in western Canada after a suspected grizzly bear attack in the same community where a bear attacked a gro
summary_zh: 该事件发生在去年11月，灰熊袭击了一群小学生的同一省份，一名母亲死亡，女儿失踪。
body_en: One dead and another missing in suspected grizzly bear attack in Canada | Canada
One dead and another missing in suspected grizzly bear attack in Canada
The incident took place in the same province where a grizzly attacked a group of schoolchildren last November
A mother is dead and her daughter is missing in western Canada after a suspected grizzly bear attack in the same community where a bear attacked a group of schoolchildren earlier in the year.

On Tuesday, the British Columbia conservation officer service said in a social media post that it had launched a search for the two missing people on the weekend, and that during the search on Sunday an officer found the mother’s body. The search for her 19-year-old daughter is ongoing.
“Our thoughts are with the families of the victims during this tragic time,” Inspector Jeff Tyre said in a video posted online.

Jenny Balcarras, an art therapist, and her daughter were reported missing by relatives over the weekend. A family member posted on Facebook about them, later updating it after the conservation service announced the suspected attack to indicate that their vehicle had been found at a trailhead near Bella Coola, British Columbia.
The suspected attack happened at the Snooka West trail area, about 8km (4.97 miles) east of Bella Coola, on the province’s central coast.

Bella Coola, a community of roughly 2,100 people, sits at the end of a fjord along the province’s central coast. Its remote location and abundant food sources mean that grizzly bears are a common sight in the region, which is informally known as the Great Bear rainforest.

Grizzly attacks in the province are exceedingly rare, but last November, 11 people, some as young as nine years old, were injured when a grizzly emerged from the forest near 4 Mile, a Nuxalk community, and attacked a school group on a lunch break alongside a walking trail. Despite an extensive search, the bear was never located.

“While the full circumstances are still unfolding, we understand first-hand the trauma this incident will inflict upon the victims’ family members, the victims of last year’s attack and the community at large,” said Samuel Schooner, elected chief of the Nuxalk Nation, on Tuesday. “Our thoughts are with the victim’s family as they learn of this tragic event.”
Schooner said a trapping effort to find the bear was under way and asked media to refrain from contacting community members.
body_zh: 加拿大疑似灰熊袭击，造成一人死亡、一人失踪加拿大
加拿大疑似灰熊袭击致一人死亡、一人失踪
该事件发生在同一省份，去年11月，灰熊袭击了一群学童
加拿大西部的一名母亲死亡，她的女儿失踪，原因是今年早些时候，同一社区发生了疑似灰熊袭击事件，该社区曾袭击过一群小学生。
周二，不列颠哥伦比亚省保护官员服务在社交媒体帖子中表示，他们已在周末启动了对两名失踪者的搜寻，并在周日的搜索过程中，一名官员发现了母亲的尸体。寻找她 19 岁女儿的工作仍在进行中。
“在这个悲惨的时刻，我们的心与受害者家属同在，”督察杰夫·泰尔在网上发布的视频中说。
艺术治疗师珍妮·巴尔卡拉斯 (Jenny Balcarras) 和她的女儿周末被亲戚报告失踪。一名家庭成员在 Facebook 上发布了有关他们的信息，并在保护机构宣布这起疑似袭击事件后更新了该信息，表明他们的车辆是在不列颠哥伦比亚省贝拉库拉附近的一个步道入口处被发现的。
疑似袭击发生在斯努卡西步道地区，位于该省中部海岸贝拉库拉以东约 8 公里（4.97 英里）处。
贝拉库拉 (Bella Coola) 是一个约有 2,100 人的社区，坐落在该省中部海岸峡湾的尽头。其偏远的地理位置和丰富的食物来源意味着灰熊是该地区的常见景观，该地区被非正式地称为大熊雨林。
该省灰熊袭击事件极为罕见，但去年 11 月，一只灰熊从 Nuxalk 社区 4 Mile 附近的森林中出现，袭击了步行道旁正在午休的一群学校，导致 11 人受伤，其中一些年仅 9 岁。尽管进行了广泛的搜索，但仍未找到这只熊。
当选的努克萨克族酋长塞缪尔·斯库纳周二表示：“虽然整个情况仍在进一步发展，但我们亲身了解这起事件将给受害者家属、去年袭击的受害者以及整个社区造成的创伤。” “当受害者的家人得知这一悲惨事件时，我们的心与他们同在。”
斯库纳表示，寻找这只熊的诱捕行动正在进行中，并要求媒体不要联系社区成员。

title_en: NTSB says crucial plane parts found three miles from Florida crash site
title_zh: 美国国家运输安全委员会表示，在距佛罗里达坠机地点三英里的地方发现了重要的飞机部件
summary: The NTSB said because the parts were found far from the accident site, they fell off before the crash.
summary_zh: 美国国家运输安全委员会表示，由于这些零件是在距离事故现场很远的地方发现的，因此它们在事故发生前就已经脱落。
body_en: NTSB says crucial plane control parts found three miles from Florida crash site - BBC News

Crucial components of a private jet that crashed in Palm Beach, Florida - including a part that controlled the up-and-down movements of the nose of the plane - were found 1.3 (2 km) to 3.8 miles away from the crash site, an investigator said on Tuesday.
National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) investigators said they believed parts of the jet may have broken off before the Sunday crash, which killed all nine on board.
The NTSB found "the majority" of the Learjet's left elevator - a control surface on the tail - in three pieces, NTSB board member Tom Chapman said.
Chapman said because the parts were "quite some distance away" from the site, investigators determined they fell off before impact.
"Knowing that it was lost is a very important piece of evidence in terms of pointing us towards other things to investigate," he said.
Chapman said officials were still working out whether losing the left elevator caused the plane to nosedive or whether the part fell off because "forces on the aircraft caused that to separate".
He said the part of the plane that controls upward and downward movement may not have been "effective" at the speed the plane was travelling.
The Learjet 60 was bound for the Bahamas from Austin, Texas, when it nosedived into a multi-lane highway and exploded on impact.
In air traffic control audio recordings, someone in the cockpit can be heard reporting "moderate turbulence" and that the crew was "managing the ice".
They are then heard saying the plane was "picking up precipitation" and "we need to climb". Moments later, the same voice said the plane was descending at a rate of 10,000ft (3,048m) per minute.
An emergency was declared and the pilots can be heard yelling "we are in an overspeed condition descending 20,000ft per minute", before saying, "we are going to crash into the ground".
NTSB plans to investigate the role weather played in the crash. Officials were struggling to access the wreckage due to the huge crater created by the jet on a road in Palm Beach.
Chapman said on Tuesday that the force of the impact severely damaged the wreckage.

Seven passengers died on board, named in a joint statement as tech entrepreneur Adam Robinson, his wife, Helen Sharp, and their two children - Emma, four, and Charlie, two - as well as friends of the family Rachael Reed and Charmi Fehr, and Anita Maria Cetina, a nanny.
The pilot was named in media reports as 55-year-old Jeffrey Gregory. Nathalia Filgueiras, 20, who earned her pilot's licence when she was 17, was reported to be the co-pilot.

body_zh: NTSB 表示在距佛罗里达坠机地点三英里的地方发现了重要的飞机控制部件 - BBC 新闻
一名调查人员周二表示，在佛罗里达州棕榈滩坠毁的一架私人飞机的重要部件（包括控制飞机机头上下运动的部件）在距坠机地点 1.3 英里（2 公里）至 3.8 英里的地方被发现。
美国国家运输安全委员会（NTSB）调查人员表示，他们认为这架飞机的部分部件可能在周日坠机事故发生前就已经断裂，导致机上九人全部遇难。
NTSB 董事会成员汤姆·查普曼 (Tom Chapman) 表示，NTSB 发现里尔喷气式飞机左升降舵（机尾的控制面）的“大部分”被分成三块。
查普曼说，由于这些部件距离现场“相当远”，调查人员确定它们在撞击前就掉落了。
他说：“知道它丢失是一个非常重要的证据，它可以指导我们调查其他事情。”
查普曼表示，官员们仍在研究是否失去左升降舵导致飞机急转，或者该部件是否因为“飞机上的力导致其分离”而掉落。
他说，飞机上控制向上和向下运动的部分在飞机的飞行速度下可能并不“有效”。
这架 Learjet 60 飞机原本从德克萨斯州奥斯汀飞往巴哈马，突然坠入多车道高速公路并在撞击时爆炸。
在空中交通管制录音中，可以听到驾驶舱内有人报告“中度湍流”，机组人员正在“处理冰层”。
然后听到他们说飞机正在“吸收降水”和“我们需要爬升”。过了一会儿，同一个声音说飞机正在以每分钟 10,000 英尺（3,048m）的速度下降。
宣布进入紧急状态，可以听到飞行员大喊“我们处于每分钟下降 20,000 英尺的超速状态”，然后又说“我们将坠落到地面”。
美国国家运输安全委员会计划调查天气在事故中所起的作用。由于这架飞机在棕榈滩的一条道路上留下了巨大的弹坑，官员们正在努力寻找残骸。
查普曼周二表示，撞击力严重损坏了残骸。
联合声明中称，机上有七名乘客死亡，他们分别是科技企业家亚当·罗宾逊、他的妻子海伦·夏普和他们的两个孩子——四岁的艾玛和两岁的查理——以及家人的朋友瑞秋·里德和查米·费尔，以及保姆安妮塔·玛丽亚·塞蒂娜。
媒体报道中称这名飞行员为 55 岁的杰弗里·格雷戈里 (Jeffrey Gregory)。据报道，20 岁的娜塔莉亚·菲尔盖拉斯 (Nathalia Filgueiras) 是副驾驶，她在 17 岁时获得了飞行员执照。

body_en: Ceasefire ends in Ukraine's Kherson region : NPR

Ceasefire ends in Ukraine's Kherson region In Kherson city, usually seething with Russian drones, friends met at cafes, families were out together and shoppers stocked up. "The city seems alive," said one resident, "just like it used to be."
For Ukraine's Kherson region, a short ceasefire meant a momentary return to normal life
A brief ceasefire in Ukraine's Kherson region has ended
People walk past the destroyed location of a cafe in Kherson, Ukraine. Svet Jacqueline for NPR hide caption
KHERSON, Ukraine — In this city where Russian drones usually fill the skies, Olena Soboleva could not easily walk down the street to meet her best friend, Anna Herasimenko.
Then came last week's truce, negotiated by First Lady Melania Trump and Pope Leo XIV, in a corner of southern Ukraine that included Kherson.
This weekend, the two friends, both 21, took the opportunity to venture outside to autumnal skies clear of drones and guided bombs.

Best friends Anna Herasimenko and Olena Soboleva, both 21, spent the ceasefire taking walks in the city and having coffee at a favorite cafe. They rarely see each other in person because constant drone attacks make it too dangerous to venture outside. Svet Jacqueline for NPR hide caption
"No drones, no explosions," Soboleva says. "No one wants to kill you."
They passed families strolling with their kids, shoppers stocking up on supplies and couples holding hands. They lined up at a cafe filled with paintings of cats.
"The city seems alive," says Herasimenko, "just like it used to be."
Over the weekend, she had also ventured to a salon.
"I did my nails," she says, showing off fresh burgundy polish. "The streets are full of people, just as they were in the past."

The truce ended Sunday night. Russia and Ukraine agreed to it in order to help Oleshky, a town across the Dnipro River from Kherson. Russian troops occupied Oleshky in 2022 and mined the land around it. Food and medicine rarely got through. NPR spoke to the families of residents there, who said their loved ones survived on pickles and boiled weeds.

Over the weekend, hundreds of Oleshky residents were evacuated, eventually escorted into northern Ukraine on buses. Dmytro Lubinets, Ukraine's ombudsman — the country's independent watchdog for human rights — thanked Melania Trump for ensuring that the ceasefire, which lasted from Oct. 27 to Nov. 1, happened.
Residents of Kherson walk into a bus at a busy public transit stop on Nov. 1, the last day of the local ceasefire. Svet Jacqueline for NPR hide caption
A woman walks past a public bus in Kherson during the ceasefire. Svet Jacqueline for NPR hide caption
Kherson residents wait for public buses under drone nets during the last days of a local ceasefire in southern Ukraine. Svet Jacqueline for NPR hide caption
"I believe they can be upheld and honored," Lubinets said about truces between Ukraine and Russia.

乌克兰赫尔松——在这座俄罗斯无人机经常布满天空的城市，奥琳娜·索博列娃(Olena Soboleva)无法轻松地走在街上去见她最好的朋友安娜·赫拉西门科(Anna Herasimenko)。
随后，上周由第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普和教皇利奥十四世在包括赫尔松在内的乌克兰南部一角达成停战协议。
这个周末，这两个都是 21 岁的朋友趁机到没有无人机和制导炸弹的秋季天空中冒险。
21 岁的好朋友安娜·赫拉西门科 (Anna Herasimenko) 和奥莱娜·索博列娃 (Olena Soboleva) 在停火期间在城里散步，并在一家最喜欢的咖啡馆喝咖啡。他们很少见面，因为持续不断的无人机袭击使得冒险外出太危险。 NPR 的斯维特·杰奎琳隐藏标题栏
“没有无人机，就没有爆炸，”索博列娃说。 “没有人想杀你。”
他们路过带着孩子散步的家庭、囤积物资的购物者和手牵着手的情侣。他们在一家挂满猫画的咖啡馆前排队。
“这座城市似乎充满了活力，”赫拉西门科说，“就像以前一样。”
周末，她还冒险去了一家沙龙。
“我做了指甲，”她一边说，一边炫耀着新鲜的酒红色指甲油。 “街上挤满了人，就像以前一样。”
休战于周日晚上结束。俄罗斯和乌克兰同意这一协议是为了帮助与赫尔松隔第聂伯河相望的奥列什基小镇。俄罗斯军队于 2022 年占领奥列什基，并在其周围的土地上布设了地雷。食物和药品很少能通过。美国国家公共广播电台采访了那里居民的家人，他们说他们的亲人靠泡菜和煮杂草生存。
周末，数百名奥列什基居民被疏散，最终被巴士护送到乌克兰北部。乌克兰监察员（该国的独立人权监督机构）感谢梅拉尼娅·特朗普确保从 10 月 27 日持续到 11 月 1 日的停火得以实现。
11 月 1 日，即当地停火的最后一天，赫尔松的居民在一个繁忙的公共交通站走进一辆公共汽车。 NPR 的斯维特·杰奎琳隐藏标题栏
停火期间，一名妇女走过赫尔松的一辆公共汽车。 NPR 的斯维特·杰奎琳隐藏标题栏
在乌克兰南部当地停火的最后几天，赫尔松居民在无人机网下等待公共巴士。 NPR 的斯维特·杰奎琳隐藏标题栏
“我相信他们能够得到维护和尊重，”鲁宾涅茨在谈到乌克兰和俄罗斯之间的休战时说道。

title_en: Where have there been technical issues so far during US midterm elections?
title_zh: 美国中期选举迄今为止出现了哪些技术问题？
summary: Some polling stations have experienced vote-delaying issues that officials describe as being minor.
summary_zh: 一些投票站出现了投票延迟问题，官员们称这些问题并不严重。
body_en: Where have there been technical issues so far during US midterm elections? | US Midterm Elections 2026 News | Al Jazeera
Share Where have there been technical issues so far during US midterm elections? on social media
US midterm elections: Voting machines malfunction in New York’s Westchester County

A handful of polling locations across the United States have reported some technical issues with how ballots are cast during the midterm elections , causing officials to delay the closing time for polls so votes can be cast.

In Westchester County, New York, north of New York City, officials said the machines meant to automatically read physical ballots were having trouble because the paper the ballots were printed on was too thick.

Al Jazeera’s Kristen Saloomey, reporting from Tarrytown, New York, said election officials were collecting ballots to be counted later manually. The machines are made by a company called Liberty Vote, a company that used to be called Dominion, which had a rocky history with US President Donald Trump, who had accused it, without evidence, of misrepresenting voting counts in past elections.

“Election officials are reassuring that they will be counted manually after everything is done,” Saloomey said, “and we don’t know of this issue in other districts across New York or the United States, and there are dozens that do use this system.”

County officials said on Tuesday that the ballots would be taken to the Board of Elections with a police escort and counted there with attorneys and representatives from all parties present, to prevent the spread of any “conspiracy” theories.
There were a number of places where technical issues have delayed things as well.
In Broward County, Florida, voting was delayed for 20 minutes at the start of the day because a new safety feature malfunctioned.
In North Carolina, the Board of Elections is considering extending voting by an hour in seven counties after widespread “technical issues” were reported.
In Arizona’s Maricopa County, a polling station at a school was temporarily closed after a power outage.
In several counties in Pennsylvania, voting has been extended by half an hour due to what officials said were “machine setup issues”.

title_en: Death toll hits 29 after Russian strike on Ukrainian aid site, with 48 still missing
title_zh: 俄罗斯袭击乌克兰援助地点已造成29人死亡，仍有48人失踪
summary: Russia launched 289 attack drones, 17 ballistic missiles and 59 cruise missiles across nine regions, President Zelenskyy said in an online post that noted the barrage coincided with U.S. elections.
summary_zh: 俄罗斯总统泽连斯基在网上发帖称，俄罗斯在九个地区发射了 289 架攻击无人机、17 枚弹道导弹和 59 枚巡航导弹。
body_en: Death toll hits 29 after Russian strike on Ukrainian aid site, with 48 still missing

In this photo provided by the Ukrainian Emergency Service, rescuers evacuate a wounded civilian from a residential building after Russian air attack in Dnipro, Ukraine, Tuesday, Nov. 3, 2026. Ukrainian Emergency Service/via AP hide caption

KYIV, Ukraine — The death toll from a Russian attack in southern Ukraine on a site where people had gathered to receive humanitarian aid rose to 29 on Tuesday, with 48 still missing, as a wave of overnight strikes targeted power plants across the country, damaged hospitals and wounded scores of people.
A brief ceasefire in Ukraine's Kherson region has ended

Dozens of rescuers and volunteers continued to search the cratered blast site of a destroyed aid facility and shelter in Komyushuvakha, a village in Ukraine's southern Zaporizhzhia region, hoping to find missing residents alive under the rubble. Instead, more bodies were pulled out and carried away in white plastic sheeting.

"The scale of the tragedy is terrifying," Mykhailo Semikin, acting head of the region's military administration, wrote in an online post. "This is one of the worst tragedies in terms of the number of civilian victims in our region since the start of the full-scale war."
A woman and her cat take shelter from a Russian drone and missile attack, in a metro station, now used as a bomb shelter, in Kyiv, Ukraine, Tuesday, Nov. 3, 2026. Danylo Antoniuk/AP hide caption

Russia launched 289 attack drones, 17 ballistic missiles and 59 cruise missiles across nine regions, triggering emergency power cuts, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said in an online post that noted the barrage coincided with U.S. elections.

"The Russians think America won't notice this signal of theirs," he said. "But we need to notice and stop such terror. We need to help Ukraine defend its skies; otherwise, Russia will never stop its missile strikes."
Three days of mourning were declared in Zaporizhzhia where Russian bunker-busting bombs, filled with nearly 1.5 tons of explosives, were used in Monday's attack.
The dead included four police officers and two rescue workers, Semikin said Tuesday. At least five people were hurt.

In this photo provided by the Ukrainian Emergency Service, a residential building is seen following a Russian air attack in Dnipro, Ukraine, Tuesday, Nov. 3, 2026. Ukrainian Emergency Service/via AP hide caption
In the northeast region of Kharkiv, a combined Russian missile and drone attack wounded at least 62 people, local authorities said.

A strike damaged a medical facility in the Nemyshlianskyi district, shattered windows in four apartment buildings and damaged cars. More than 200 patients were transferred to other medical facilities, head of the regional military administration Oleh Syniehubov said.
In the Dnipro area, rescuers pulled a woman alive from the rubble Tuesday morning, after a Russian attack killed one person and wounded 17, local authorities said.
The attack damaged an outpatient clinic and a hospital. Patients were transferred to other hospitals, Oleksandr Hanzha, head of the regional military administration, said.
Russia's Ministry of Defense said Tuesday that it had shot down 856 Ukrainian drones overnight. Moscow mayor Sergei Sobyanin said 493 drones were fired toward the Russian capital.
How AI drones are influencing the course of the Ukraine war

A Ukrainian drone attack wounded two employees at an oil refinery in the Russian city of Yaroslavl, regional Gov. Mikhail Yevrayev said Tuesday. He added that there was damage to the refinery's infrastructure.
Rolling blackouts have been instituted in the south, west and east of Russian-occupied Crimea following attacks on energy infrastructure, Moscow-installed officials said Tuesday.
body_zh: 俄罗斯袭击乌克兰援助地点已造成29人死亡，仍有48人失踪
在乌克兰紧急服务部门提供的这张照片中，2026 年 11 月 3 日星期二，俄罗斯空袭乌克兰第聂伯罗后，救援人员从一栋住宅楼疏散一名受伤平民。乌克兰紧急服务部门/来自美联社 隐藏标题栏
乌克兰基辅——周二，俄罗斯在乌克兰南部一处人们聚集接受人道主义援助的地点发动袭击，死亡人数上升至 29 人，仍有 48 人失踪，一波连夜袭击袭击了全国各地的发电厂，医院受损，数十人受伤。
乌克兰赫尔松地区短暂停火结束
数十名救援人员和志愿者继续在乌克兰南部扎波罗热地区 Komyushuvakha 村庄的一个被摧毁的援助设施和避难所的爆炸现场进行搜索，希望能找到瓦砾下还活着的失踪居民。相反，更多的尸体被拉出来并用白色塑料布运走。
“这场悲剧的规模令人恐惧，”该地区军事管理局代理负责人米哈伊洛·塞米金(Mykhailo Semikin)在网上发帖写道。 “就我们地区的平民受害者人数而言，这是自全面战争开始以来最严重的悲剧之一。”
2026 年 11 月 3 日，星期二，乌克兰基辅，一名妇女和她的猫在乌克兰基辅的一个地铁站躲避俄罗斯无人机和导弹的袭击，该地铁站现已用作防空洞。 Danylo Antoniuk/美联社 隐藏标题栏
俄罗斯总统泽连斯基在网上发帖称，俄罗斯向九个地区发射了 289 架攻击无人机、17 枚弹道导弹和 59 枚巡航导弹，引发紧急断电，并指出此次袭击恰逢美国大选。
“俄罗斯人认为美国不会注意到他们的这一信号，”他说。 “但我们需要注意到并制止这种恐怖行为。我们需要帮助乌克兰保卫其天空；否则，俄罗斯将永远不会停止其导弹袭击。”
扎波罗热宣布哀悼三天，周一的袭击事件中使用了装有近 1.5 吨炸药的俄罗斯炸弹。
塞米金周二表示，死者包括四名警察和两名救援人员。至少有五人受伤。
在乌克兰紧急服务部门提供的这张照片中，2026 年 11 月 3 日星期二，乌克兰第聂伯罗发生俄罗斯空袭后，可以看到一栋住宅楼。乌克兰紧急服务部门/来自美联社 隐藏标题栏
地方当局称，在哈尔科夫东北部地区，俄罗斯导弹和无人机联合袭击造成至少 62 人受伤。
罢工损坏了涅梅什利安斯基区的一处医疗设施，四栋公寓楼的窗户被震碎，汽车也被损坏。地区军事管理局局长奥列·西涅胡博夫 (Oleh Syniehubov) 表示，有 200 多名患者被转移到其他医疗机构。
地方当局称，周二上午，在第聂伯罗地区，俄罗斯发动袭击，导致 1 人死亡、17 人受伤，救援人员从废墟中救出了一名妇女。
这次袭击损坏了一家门诊诊所和一家医院。地区军事管理局局长亚历山大·汉扎 (Oleksandr Hanzha) 表示，患者已被转移到其他医院。
俄罗斯国防部周二表示，一夜之间击落了 856 架乌克兰无人机。莫斯科市长谢尔盖·索比亚宁表示，有 493 架无人机向俄罗斯首都发射。
人工智能无人机如何影响乌克兰战争的进程
俄罗斯雅罗斯拉夫尔市州长米哈伊尔·叶夫拉耶夫周二表示，乌克兰无人机袭击造成俄罗斯雅罗斯拉夫尔市一家炼油厂的两名员工受伤。他补充说，炼油厂的基础设施遭到损坏。
莫斯科派驻的官员周二表示，在能源基础设施遭到袭击后，俄罗斯占领的克里米亚南部、西部和东部已经实行轮流停电。

title_en: Spanish transport minister resigns days after deadly train crash
title_zh: 致命火车事故几天后西班牙交通部长辞职
summary: At least 69 people were killed and dozens injured in the collision south of the capital, Madrid.
summary_zh: 首都马德里以南的撞车事故已造成至少 69 人死亡、数十人受伤。
body_en: Spain's Transport Minister Óscar Puente has resigned - six days after the high-speed train collision in which at least 69 people were killed and dozens injured.

He announced his decision in Congress, after giving evidence on last Wednesday's disaster near the town of Urda, south of the capital Madrid, in which a train smashed into the back of a stationary train.

"A transport minister in a country like Spain cannot remain in office after two accidents of this seriousness in less than a year," he said - a reference to January's crash on the same line which left 46 people dead.
Last week's crash was one of the worst rail disasters in Europe's modern history, and Spain's worst crash since 2013.
Puente announced his decision at the end of a lengthy congressional session on Tuesday evening in which he had outlined new rail safety measures and had been grilled by the opposition.
He also said: "I am not only stepping down from my position as minister of transport, but... I am also withdrawing my name from the lists for the early legislative elections."
Puente's position immediately came under scrutiny after the 28 October crash.
The main opposition, the conservative People's Party (PP) and the far-right Vox, were both calling for his resignation - as were some of the government's allies.

They argued that the minister should take responsibility for a high-speed rail system that many Spaniards now regard as unsafe and whose credibility even Socialist Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez admitted was "broken".
The opposition also criticised Puente for appearing to blame human error for the crash, claiming the minister was trying to deflect the blame from his own failings.
But, having said he was going to remain in his post just a few days ago, his resignation appears to have taken many by surprise.
The rail accident and Puente's decision have come at a crucial moment in the Spanish political calendar, with early general elections on 29 November.
Many observers see the accident as a massive electoral setback to the Socialist-led government that will make it impossible for Sánchez to defy the polls and win the election.

Puente's predicament presented him and the prime minister with a dilemma - refusing to resign might look insensitive in the wake of the accident and stepping down could look like acknowledging he and the government were at fault.
In the end, Puente opted for the second option, insisting his decision had been driven by "political dignity".
The prime minister praised his colleague who had "faced up to the situation, provided answers and solutions, and then stepped aside".
"Out of dignity. Of his own accord. Out of respect for the victims," Sánchez added.
Many Spaniards will now ask whether Puente's successors will manage to restore faith in the country's railway system.
Last Wednesday's accident involved a train run by state-owned operator Renfe with 397 passengers on board and a stationary train run by private operator Iryo, which was carrying 147 passengers.
A reported issue with the automatic signalling system - a computer failure - had forced all trains to halt on the affected stretch.
body_zh: 造成至少 69 人死亡、数十人受伤的高速列车相撞事件发生六天后，西班牙交通部长奥斯卡·普恩特 (Óscar Puente) 辞职。
他在就上周三首都马德里以南乌尔达镇附近发生的灾难提供证据后，在国会宣布了自己的决定，当时一列火车撞上了静止的火车尾部。
他说：“在不到一年的时间里发生了两起如此严重的事故，像西班牙这样的国家的交通部长就不能继续任职了。”他指的是 1 月份在同一条线路上发生的导致 46 人死亡的事故。
上周的事故是欧洲现代史上最严重的铁路灾难之一，也是西班牙自 2013 年以来最严重的事故。
普恩特在周二晚上漫长的国会会议结束时宣布了他的决定，会上他概述了新的铁路安全措施，并遭到了反对派的拷问。
他还表示：“我不仅要辞去交通部长的职务，而且……我还要从早期立法选举的名单中撤回我的名字。”
10 月 28 日崩盘后，Puente 的立场立即受到密切关注。
主要反对党保守派人民党和极右翼 Vox 都要求他辞职，政府的一些盟友也是如此。
他们认为，部长应该对高铁系统承担责任，许多西班牙人现在认为该系统不安全，甚至连社会党总理佩德罗·桑切斯也承认其信誉“被破坏”。
反对派还批评普恩特似乎将坠机事故归咎于人为错误，声称部长试图将责任归咎于自己的失误。
但是，几天前他还表示将继续留任，但他的辞职似乎让许多人感到惊讶。
此次铁路事故和普恩特的决定正值西班牙政治日程的关键时刻，大选将于 11 月 29 日提前举行。
许多观察家认为，这次事故对社会党领导的政府来说是一次巨大的选举挫折，这将使桑切斯不可能违抗民意调查并赢得选举。
普恩特的困境让他和总理陷入了两难的境地——在事故发生后拒绝辞职可能会显得麻木不仁，而辞职可能会让人觉得承认他和政府有过错。
最终，普恩特选择了第二种选择，坚称他的决定是出于“政治尊严”。
总理赞扬他的同事“正视情况，提供答案和解决方案，然后退到一边”。
“出于尊严。出于他自己的意愿。出于对受害者的尊重，”桑切斯补充道。
许多西班牙人现在会问普恩特的继任者是否能够恢复人们对该国铁路系统的信心。
上周三的事故涉及一列由国有运营商 Renfe 运营的列车，车上有 397 名乘客，以及一列由私人运营商 Iryo 运营的固定列车，车上载有 147 名乘客。
据报道，自动信号系统出现问题——计算机故障——迫使所有列车在受影响的路段停下来。

title_en: Tenerife striker De Miguel dies after on-field collision

summary_zh: 特内里费岛前锋赫苏斯·德米格尔在一场西班牙乙级联赛的比赛中发生场内碰撞，不幸身亡，享年 30 岁。
body_en: Tenerife striker Jesus de Miguel has died after the 30-year-old suffered a serious injury during a Spanish second-division match.
The forward suffered head and chest injuries during a match against FC Andorra on Monday in a heavy collision with goalkeeper Jesus Owono, who was sent off for his challenge.
De Miguel's condition was described as 'stable but serious' on Monday but his health deteriorated on Tuesday morning, with the Spaniard dying at 07:00 GMT.
Reuters reported on Tuesday that police in Spain have opened an investigation for possible involuntary manslaughter following De Miguel's death.
Under Spanish law, any death that is deemed non-natural automatically triggers a judicial inquiry.
"Heartbroken, with a lump in our throats and unable to believe this is true" Tenerife said.

"There are no words of comfort; there is absolutely nothing that can lessen this overwhelming sadness. We stand with his grieving family, with his loved ones, with all of Tenerife who mourn this cruel loss today."
Tenerife and Andorra were drawing 2-2 seven minutes into stoppage time when the incident occurred.
Owono ran towards the centre circle to clear a long ball when his knee appeared to collide with De Miguel.
The striker lay motionless on the pitch as medical staff treated him before he was taken by ambulance from Tenerife's Estadio Heliodoro Rodriguez Lopez to hospital.
Players from both teams were visibly distressed by the incident, with a number of De Miguel's team-mates in tears.
The referee showed Owono a straight red card before abandoning the match.
The goalkeeper, who had over 30,000 followers on Instagram on Tuesday morning, has since deactivated his account.
Spanish media, including Marca, reported De Miguel suffered a cardiac arrest in the ambulance and was resuscitated by paramedics on the way to hospital.
Tenerife's president, Felipe Minambres, says the club's players will need "professional assistance" to help deal with the ordeal of one of their team-mates dying.
"We are all feeling vulnerable and deeply saddened right now. It's hard to even believe what has happened," said Minambres.
"We know, especially the players and the players' partners, that we will need support. We've already begun receiving offers of help today, and that support will continue.
"We will need professional assistance, but we also need the support of all our fans, because they are likely feeling the same way we are today."
Minambres added it had been a "truly unbelievable situation" and "an enormous tragedy that we have had to endure".

Andorra, Tenerife's opponents on Monday, issued a statement later on Tuesday which spoke of the club's shock and expressed condolences to De Miguel's family, club "and all those who were close to him".
body_zh: 特内里费岛前锋热苏斯·德米格尔现年 30 岁，在西班牙乙级联赛的一场比赛中受重伤，不幸身亡。
这位前锋在周一对阵安道尔足球俱乐部的比赛中与门将赫苏斯·奥沃诺发生严重碰撞，头部和胸部受伤，奥沃诺因犯规被罚下场。
周一，德米格尔的病情被描述为“稳定但严重”，但他的健康状况在周二早上恶化，西班牙人于格林尼治标准时间 07:00 去世。
路透社周二报道称，德米格尔死后，西班牙警方已就可能的过失杀人事件展开调查。
根据西班牙法律，任何被视为非自然死亡的行为都会自动触发司法调查。
特内里费岛说：“我们心碎了，喉咙哽住，无法相信这是真的。”
“没有任何安慰的话；绝对没有什么可以减轻这种压倒性的悲伤。我们与他悲伤的家人、他的亲人以及整个特内里费岛站在一起，他们今天哀悼这一残酷的损失。”
事件发生时，特内里费岛和安道尔队在补时7分钟时2-2战平。
当奥沃诺的膝盖似乎与德米格尔相撞时，奥沃诺跑向中圈解围长球。
这名前锋一动不动地躺在球场上，医护人员对他进行了治疗，然后他被救护车从特内里费岛的埃利奥多罗·罗德里格斯·洛佩斯体育场送往医院。
两支球队的球员显然都对这一事件感到痛苦，德米格尔的一些队友流下了眼泪。
裁判直接向奥沃诺出示了红牌，然后放弃了比赛。
周二早上，这名门将在 Instagram 上拥有超过 30,000 名粉丝，此后他已经停用了自己的账户。
包括《马卡报》在内的西班牙媒体报道称，德米格尔在救护车上心脏骤停，在送往医院的途中被医护人员复苏。
特内里费岛主席费利佩·米南布雷斯表示，俱乐部的球员需要“专业援助”来帮助应对其中一名队友去世的痛苦。
米纳布雷斯说：“我们现在都感到脆弱和深深的悲伤。很难相信发生了什么事。”
“我们知道，特别是球员和球员的合作伙伴，我们需要支持。今天我们已经开始收到帮助，这种支持将继续下去。
“我们需要专业的帮助，但我们也需要所有球迷的支持，因为他们可能和我们今天的感受一样。”
米南布雷斯补充说，这是“真正令人难以置信的情况”，也是“我们不得不忍受的巨大悲剧”。
特内里费岛周一的对手安道尔周二晚些时候发表声明，表达了俱乐部的震惊，并向德米格尔的家人、俱乐部“以及所有与他关系密切的人”表示哀悼。

title_en: Seven flights across Europe targeted by suspected bomb threats
title_zh: 欧洲七架航班受到疑似炸弹威胁
summary: Planes in Poland, Spain, Bulgaria and Italy have been checked for explosives following separate threats.
summary_zh: 波兰、西班牙、保加利亚和意大利的飞机在收到分别的威胁后已接受爆炸物检查。
body_en: Flights from UK airports among seven across Europe targeted by suspected bomb threats - BBC News
By Emer Moreau , Jaroslav Lukiv and Laura Gozzi , Europe reporter
Seven passenger planes across Europe, two of which departed from the UK, have been inspected following a series of suspected bomb threats.

Two Ryanair flights, one originating from Dublin and the other from Lisbon, were searched after landing in Rome following anonymous tips but no explosives were found, sources at the city's Fiumicino airport told the BBC.
The Dublin flight was escorted by the Italian Air Force until landing. Authorities have also searched planes in Poland, Spain and Bulgaria.
While officially there is no link between them, authorities from various countries will be co-operating to assess whether this was a co-ordinated attack, designed to disrupt airspace.
The UK government described the incidents as "malicious hoax threats".

In a statement it said it had "one of the most robust aviation security systems in the world, with well-tested processes for dealing with any potential threats, as well as malicious hoax threats, like those we've seen today".
Aviation security expert Paul Mason said bomb threats on passenger planes "don't happen that frequently", which made the latest incidents "unusual".

"It sounds like they've been made in a credible manner across a broad range of airlines," Mason told BBC Radio 5 Live. "That would suggest to me that it's been a very deliberate act by a typical actor rather than a load of coincidental, malicious calls."
He said "there are a lot of processes" that the onboard crew and people on the ground must go through "to validate the credibility of the threat".

A flight may be asked to divert if the credibility of a threat "is of a certain level", Mason added, and in some cases the onboard crew may not even be advised on what the ground operators were dealing with.
In Rome, sources at Fiumicino airport told the BBC police bomb disposal experts carried out standard security protocols to ensure the safety of all passengers and crew.
Inspections of the passengers, luggage, and the aircraft yielded negative results, and the alert has since been cleared.
One plane which landed in Murcia, southern Spain - a Ryanair flight coming from Manchester - was also found not to have any explosives on board, Spanish authorities said.
One passenger later said she was unaware of the bomb threat until after the plane landed.
"We weren't told anything during the flight," Sarah told BBC Radio 5 Live. "The plane stopped quite suddenly and then we were kept on the runway for around 30 minutes."
"Then the fire engines turned up, the bomb squad turned up and we were asked to evacuate," she continues.

Sarah said the plane had not been on the ground a minute before it was "surrounded by fire engines and police and a bomb squad". All the passengers were then escorted by police, leaving all their belongings.
"We were only later told that it was an actual threat, a bomb threat to the plane itself," she added.
body_zh: 欧洲七个机场中来自英国机场的航班受到疑似炸弹威胁 -_澳门赌博平台
作者：Emer Moreau、Jaroslav Lukiv 和 Laura Gozzi，欧洲记者
欧洲各地的七架客机（其中两架从英国起飞）在一系列疑似炸弹威胁后接受了检查。
菲乌米奇诺机场的消息人士告诉英国广播公司，瑞安航空的两架航班，一架从都柏林起飞，另一架从里斯本起飞，在匿名举报后降落在罗马后接受了搜查，但没有发现爆炸物。
都柏林航班由意大利空军护航直至着陆。当局还在波兰、西班牙和保加利亚搜查了飞机。
虽然官方称两者之间没有联系，但各国当局将合作评估这是否是一次旨在扰乱领空的协同攻击。
英国政府将这些事件描述为“恶意骗局威胁”。
它在一份声明中表示，它拥有“世界上最强大的航空安全系统之一，拥有经过充分测试的流程，可以处理任何潜在威胁以及恶意恶作剧威胁，就像我们今天看到的那样”。
航空安全专家保罗·梅森表示，针对客机的炸弹威胁“并不经常发生”，这使得最近的事件“不寻常”。
梅森告诉 BBC 广播电台 5 现场直播：“听起来，许多航空公司都以可靠的方式制作了这些产品。” “这对我来说意味着这是一个典型的演员非常故意的行为，而不是一堆巧合的恶意电话。”
他说，机上船员和地面人员必须经历“许多流程”，“以验证威胁的可信度”。
梅森补充说，如果威胁的可信度“达到一定程度”，航班可能会被要求改道，在某些情况下，机组人员甚至可能不知道地面运营商正在处理什么。
在罗马，菲乌米奇诺机场的消息人士告诉 BBC 警方拆弹专家执行了标准安全协议，以确保所有乘客和机组人员的安全。
对乘客、行李和飞机的检查结果均为阴性，警报现已解除。
西班牙当局表示，一架从曼彻斯特起飞的瑞安航空航班降落在西班牙南部穆尔西亚，飞机上也没有发现任何爆炸物。
一名乘客后来说，直到飞机着陆后她才意识到炸弹威胁。
“在飞行过程中我们没有被告知任何事情，”莎拉告诉 BBC 广播 5 直播。 “飞机突然停了下来，然后我们在跑道上停留了大约 30 分钟。”
“然后消防车出现了，拆弹小组也出现了，我们被要求撤离，”她继续说道。
莎拉说，飞机落地一分钟后就“被消防车、警察和拆弹小组包围”。随后，所有乘客都被警察护送，留下了所有财物。
“我们后来才得知这是一个真正的威胁，是对飞机本身的炸弹威胁，”她补充道。

title_en: Irish Olympian Ciara Mageean was a 'talented and inspirational human being'
title_zh: 爱尔兰奥运选手席亚拉·马吉恩是一位“才华横溢、鼓舞人心的人”
summary: The former European champion and two-time Olympic runner had been diagnosed with stage four bowel cancer.
summary_zh: 这位前欧洲冠军和两届奥运会跑步运动员被诊断出患有第四期肠癌。
body_en: Olympian Ciara Mageean has been described as a "truly remarkable, immensely talented and inspirational human being" in a tribute read out at her funeral.
Hundreds of people have paid their respects to the runner at her funeral on Tuesday.
The former European champion and two-time Olympic runner died on Sunday after she was diagnosed with stage four bowel cancer.

Among those in attendance at the funeral in Portaferry, County Down, were Northern Ireland First Minister Michelle O'Neill, as well as fellow Olympian Rhys McClenaghan and 1972 gold medallist Lady Mary Peters.
Mageean's funeral cortege was given a guard of honour by Portaferry GAC and her former school, Assumption Grammar in Ballynahinch.
Her death comes less than three weeks after her marriage to her long-term partner Thomas Moran.
Mourners began arriving at around midday for the 2:00 GMT requiem Mass at St Patrick's Church.
Family, friends and those wishing to pay their respects followed the funeral cortege the short distance along the Ballyphilip Road from Mageean's family home to the church.

Others in attendance included representatives for Irish President Catherine Connolly and the Irish Government, Social Democratic and Labour Party leader Claire Hanna, GAA President Jarlath Burns and former boxer Paddy Barnes.
The Mass booklet included an image of Mageean's greatest achievement on the track, the moment she crossed the line at the 2024 European Championships.
In his homily, Father Martin Kelly, who knew Mageean from her childhood, spoke of her accomplishments, her love for her husband and the joy and pride she had brought to her hometown.
Kelly recalled visiting her in hospice shortly before her death, when she suggested they go for a walk.
Despite her illness, Mageean noticed he was struggling and offered to link arms with him.
"On the way down, she knew I was struggling and she said, 'Let me link you'," he told mourners.
"One of my happiest moments and memories is that of Ciara Mageean linking my arm as we walked back to her room."
The athlete represented Ireland at the 2016 and 2020 Olympics and won gold in the 1500m at the European Athletics Championships in Rome in 2024.
She also represented Northern Ireland at the Commonwealth Games, winning silver in Birmingham in 2022.
Noticing blood in your poo - which may appear black or dark red in the toilet bowl - can be a sign of bowel cancer.
If there is no other obvious cause for the bleeding, such as piles, the NHS recommends that you ask for an appointment with your GP , external .
The NHS also advises a check-up if you notice changes in your regular toilet habits, such as having to poo more often, or a pattern of diarrhoea or constipation.
body_zh: 奥运会选手席亚拉·马吉安 (Ciara Magean) 在葬礼上宣读的悼词中被描述为“真正非凡、才华横溢、鼓舞人心的人”。
周二，数百人在这位跑步者的葬礼上向她表示敬意。
这位前欧洲冠军和两届奥运会跑步运动员在被诊断出患有第四期肠癌后于周日去世。
参加在唐郡波塔费里举行的葬礼的包括北爱尔兰首席部长米歇尔·奥尼尔、奥运选手里斯·麦克莱纳汉和 1972 年金牌得主玛丽·彼得斯女士。
Mageean 的葬礼队伍由 Portaferry GAC 和她以前的学校（位于 Ballynahinch 的 Asmination Grammar）安排了仪仗队。
她与长期伴侣托马斯·莫兰结婚后不到三周就去世了。
中午左右，哀悼者开始抵达圣帕特里克教堂参加格林尼治标准时间 2:00 的安魂弥撒。
家人、朋友和那些希望表达敬意的人跟随葬礼队伍，沿着巴利菲利普路从马吉恩的家到教堂。
其他出席者包括爱尔兰总统凯瑟琳·康诺利和爱尔兰政府的代表、社会民主党和工党领袖克莱尔·汉纳、GAA 主席贾拉斯·伯恩斯和前拳击手帕迪·巴恩斯。
弥撒小册子中包含了马吉恩在赛道上取得的最伟大成就的图片，即她在 2024 年欧洲锦标赛上冲过终点线的那一刻。
从小就认识马吉恩的马丁·凯利神父在讲道中谈到了她的成就、她对丈夫的爱以及她给家乡带来的欢乐和自豪。
凯利回忆起她去世前不久去临终关怀医院探望她，当时她建议他们去散步。
尽管生病了，马吉安还是注意到他正在挣扎，并主动与他挽着手。
“在下山的路上，她知道我正在挣扎，她说，‘让我联系你’，”他告诉哀悼者。
“我最快乐的时刻和回忆之一就是当我们走回她的房间时，席亚拉·马吉恩挽着我的手臂。”
这位运动员代表爱尔兰参加了 2016 年和 2020 年奥运会，并在 2024 年罗马欧洲田径锦标赛上获得了 1500 米金牌。
她还代表北爱尔兰参加了 2022 年伯明翰英联邦运动会并获得银牌。

如果没有其他明显的出血原因，例如痔疮，NHS 建议您要求与您的外科医生预约。
如果您发现常规如厕习惯发生变化，例如需要更频繁地排便，或者出现腹泻或便秘的情况，NHS 还建议您进行检查。

title_en: Binance says fake job interviews used as part of $6.3bn crypto hack
title_zh: 币安称，虚假工作面试被用作价值 63 亿美元的加密货币黑客攻击的一部分
summary: An engineer was contacted through a legitimate job-hunting platform and invited to bogus job interviews with fake company representatives, Binance says.
summary_zh: 币安称，一名工程师通过合法的求职平台获得联系，并受邀参加虚假公司代表的虚假面试
body_en: Hackers who stole a record $6.3bn (£4.7bn) from Binance used fake job interviews and a compromised internal AI tool, the firm has revealed.
Initial findings published by the company, which operates the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, said hackers gained access to its systems through "sophisticated, multi-stage campaign".

It said they used a range of techniques such as malicious software downloads to compromise the computers of Binance engineers and gain control over tools to drain its wallet of billions of dollars worth of crypto.
Binance called it a "serious and highly sophisticated security incident" and apologised, saying "this should not have happened".
In a post on X , external , Binance said hackers targeted its engineers using social engineering techniques.
These see hackers use approaches such as phishing to trick people into parting with sensitive or personal details, that can then be used to try and access their accounts.
Binance said as part of the hack, one of its engineers was contacted through a legitimate job-hunting platform and invited to bogus job interviews with fake company representatives.
It said the perpetrators used "more advanced and deceptive" methods to build trust with him, such as sharing social media accounts that contained personal images.
The engineer in question was instructed to download malware masquerading as an "assignment" during a second interview, that deployed malicious code with "obfuscation techniques" evading detection.

Binance said hackers then leveraged the engineer's compromised computer and a compromised internal AI tool in October to gain control over two other engineers' laptops, and execute the next steps of the attack.
The incident led Binance to suspend withdrawals for customers globally, meaning users could not get their cryptocurrency out of the platform until the service was restored on Sunday.
Customers withdrew billions of dollars worth of assets after it reopened .
"We apologise for the concern, disruption and uncertainty it caused our users, partners and the wider industry," it said.
The company added it had taken a range of steps following the incident, including working with law enforcement to trace and freeze affected assets.
It said it had also set aside more than 100% of the funds needed to cover the loss, noting 98% of the token assets impacted had been "replenished" as of Saturday.
The record $6.3bn (£4.7bn) attack is thought to be the largest crypto hack to date .
US crime agencies, including the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) and Secret Service, have been assisting Binance in tracing the crypto taken from the platform's own wallets.
The agencies, along with a range of cyber analysts, said that the hack - like similar breaches before it - bore the signs of having been orchestrated by North Korea.
Pyongyang hit back at the claims on Tuesday , denying it was behind the hack.

Kim Yo Jong, a top Democratic People's Republic of Korea official and the sister of leader Kim Jong Un, said on the accusations were another "sinister attempt" by the US to damage North Korea's public image.

该公司运营着全球最大的加密货币交易所，其发布的初步调查结果称，黑客通过“复杂的多阶段活动”进入了其系统。
该公司表示，他们使用恶意软件下载等一系列技术来破坏币安工程师的计算机，并获得对工具的控制权，从而耗尽其钱包中价值数十亿美元的加密货币。
币安称其为“严重且高度复杂的安全事件”，并致歉，称“这种情况不应该发生”。
币安在 X 外部帖子中表示，黑客利用社会工程技术瞄准了其工程师。
这些事件中，黑客使用网络钓鱼等方法来诱骗人们泄露敏感或个人信息，然后利用这些信息来尝试访问他们的帐户。
币安表示，作为黑客攻击的一部分，通过合法的求职平台联系了其一名工程师，并邀请其与假公司代表进行虚假工作面试。
报告称，肇事者使用“更先进和欺骗性”的方法与他建立信任，例如分享包含个人图像的社交媒体帐户。
在第二次采访中，相关工程师被指示下载伪装成“任务”的恶意软件，该恶意软件使用“混淆技术”部署恶意代码来逃避检测。
币安表示，黑客随后在 10 月份利用该工程师受损的计算机和受损的内部人工智能工具控制了另外两名工程师的笔记本电脑，并执行了下一步的攻击。
该事件导致币安暂停全球客户的提款，这意味着在周日服务恢复之前，用户无法从平台提取加密货币。
重新开业后，客户撤回了价值数十亿美元的资产。
声明称：“我们对它给我们的用户、合作伙伴和更广泛的行业带来的担忧、干扰和不确定性表示歉意。”
该公司补充说，事件发生后已采取一系列措施，包括与执法部门合作追踪和冻结受影响的资产。
该公司表示，还预留了超过 100% 的资金来弥补损失，并指出截至周六，98% 受影响的代币资产已得到“补充”。
这次创纪录的 63 亿美元（47 亿英镑）攻击被认为是迄今为止最大的加密货币黑客攻击。
包括联邦调查局 (FBI) 和特勤局在内的美国犯罪机构一直在协助币安追踪从该平台自己的钱包中获取的加密货币。
这些机构以及一系列网络分析师表示，这次黑客攻击——就像之前的类似违规行为一样——有迹象表明是朝鲜精心策划的。
平壤周二对这些说法进行了回击，否认其是此次黑客攻击的幕后黑手。

title_en: Why South Africa's local elections matter
title_zh: 为什么南非地方选举很重要
summary: South Africans head to the polls on Wednesday amid water shortages, frustration with local services and questions over whether the ANC's support will keep falling.
summary_zh: 南非人周三前往投票站，原因是水资源短缺、对当地服务的不满以及对非国大的支持是否会继续存在的疑问。
body_en: "We've decided not to vote. At all," Vatiswa Zoya said two days before voters in South Africa cast their ballots for new municipal government leaders. "What is the point? We will still sleep hungry."
These very same frustrations are what will lead 22-year-old Lindokuhle Mbandazayo to the polls, although she has yet to decide where to place her cross.

"When we vote for councilors, we ask them to fix the area," Mbandazayo told DW. "The electricity goes off regularly here. There is also sewage in the streets, and we have to jump over this. There are a lot of things that need to be fixed here."

Both women live in Tembisa, a township in Ekurhuleni, a municipality on the outskirts of Johannesburg, South Africa's largest city. Both express an "embedded frustration" over their living conditions.
Sanusha Naidu, an analyst at the Institute for Global Dialogue, said it was this "embedded frustration" that prompts people to vote.
"Your vote actually puts some of these political parties' feet to the fire, but I think that frustration is also inherently coming from the fact that it's not going to happen overnight," Naidu said.

On Wednesday, South Africans will vote in municipal elections that will determine control of the country's largest cities and test whether the African National Congress (ANC) , the leading party in the national government coalition, continues its electoral decline.
Here are five things to know about Wednesday's election.
Many voters will be motivated by whether they can shower or not on election day, as many parts of South Africa experience water supply issues.
In Johannesburg, several neighborhoods have faced water cuts and rationing for weeks as old infrastructure struggles to keep up with supply.

"Every province has an issue. So if we take for example drinking water quality, half of the drinking water systems in South Africa are not fit for drinking," Ferrial Adam, executive director of water rights NGO WaterCAN, told DW at a protest over water cuts in Johannesburg.

"Almost 70% of our wastewater treatment works are in a critical state and spewing sewage into rivers and streams across the country," Adam said. "It is a definite water crisis across South Africa," she added.
In Tshwane, a metropolitan area that includes South Africa's administrative capital, Pretoria, a recent water treatment failure left more than 400 residents sick.

Sanusha Naidu, an analyst at the Institute for Global Dialogue, said that, despite widespread worries about water quality and supply, many candidates have not provided adequate details on their solutions.

"I think their promises have been very transactional," Naidu said. "Their promises are always, you know: 'We're going to bring water to your community. We're going to make sure the taps are flowing. We're going to ensure that we're going to deal with the old infrastructure around water, etc.' But I don't think they've dug deeper in terms of understanding what the budgets say about water access."
Many voters place blame for the state of municipalities on the African National Congress, which has historically held an outright majority in most municipalities.

In 2016 the ANC secured 53.91% of the overall vote and had an outright majority in 161 of 213 councils. In 2021, that decreased to 45.59% of the overall vote with a majority in 122 of 213 municipalities.
The global marketing research firm Ipsos predicts that the party's support could fall as low as 30% in this election, resulting in an increase in coalition-run municipalities.

body_zh: “我们决定不投票。根本不投票，”南非选民投票选出新市政府领导人的两天前，瓦蒂斯瓦·佐亚 (Vatiswa Zoya) 说道。 “这有什么意义？我们还是饿着肚子睡觉吧。”
同样的挫败感也将导致 22 岁的 Lindokuhle Mbandazayo 参加投票，尽管她尚未决定将十字架放在哪里。
姆班达扎约告诉德国之声：“当我们投票选出议员时，我们要求他们修复该地区。” “这里经常断电。街上还有污水，我们必须跳过这个。这里有很多东西需要修理。”
两名妇女都住在南非最大城市约翰内斯堡郊区埃库胡莱尼市的一个小镇坦比萨。两人都对自己的生活条件表达了“深深的挫败感”。
全球对话研究所分析师萨努沙·奈杜表示，正是这种“内在的挫败感”促使人们投票。
奈杜说：“你的投票实际上让其中一些政党陷入困境，但我认为挫败感本质上也来自于这样一个事实：这不会在一夜之间发生。”
周三，南非人将在市政选举中投票，该选举将决定对该国最大城市的控制权，并检验国家政府联盟中的主要政党非洲人国民大会（ANC）是否会继续其选举下滑。
以下是有关周三选举需要了解的五件事。
由于南非许多地区都面临供水问题，许多选民的动机是在选举日是否可以洗澡。
在约翰内斯堡，由于旧的基础设施难以跟上供应，几个社区连续数周面临断水和配给。
“每个省都有一个问题。因此，如果我们以饮用水质量为例，南非有一​​半的饮用水系统不适合饮用，”水权非政府组织WaterCAN的执行董事费里亚尔·亚当(Ferrial Adam)在约翰内斯堡举行的一场关于减水的抗议活动中告诉德国之声。
Adam 说：“我们近 70% 的废水处理厂处于危急状态，污水不断排入全国各地的河流和溪流。” “整个南非确实面临着水危机，”她补​​充道。
在包括南非行政首都比勒陀利亚在内的茨瓦内大都市区，最近的一次水处理故障导致 400 多名居民患病。
全球对话研究所分析师萨努沙·奈杜表示，尽管人们普遍担心水质和供应，但许多候选人并未提供有关其解决方案的足够细节。
“我认为他们的承诺非常具有交易性，”奈杜说。 “你知道，他们的承诺始终是：‘我们将为您的社区供水。我们将确保水龙头畅通。我们将确保处理水周围的旧基础设施等。’但我认为他们并没有更深入地了解预算对供水的规定。”
许多选民将城市的现状归咎于非洲人国民大会，该党历来在大多数城市中占据绝对多数席位。
2016 年，非国大获得了 53.91% 的总选票，并在 213 个议会中的 161 个议会中获得绝对多数。 2021 年，这一比例下降至 45.59%，在 213 个城市中的 122 个城市中获得多数票。
全球营销研究公司益普索(Ipsos)预测，该党在本次选举中的支持率可能会下降至30%，导致联合政府执政的城市数量增加。
